read.en: Rockwell rose 1.0% on Oct 28 to $443.81, trading between $441.45 and $446.74. It is above the rising 5-day ($432.58), 10-day ($430.19), 30-day ($432.62) and 200-day ($426.80) averages and just below the falling 100-day ($446.30). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27 and is now above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($413.23), and RSI is 58.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 10月28日上涨 1.0%，收于 $443.81，盘中区间 $441.45–446.74。股价位于上行的 5 日（$432.58）、10 日（$430.19）、30 日（$432.62）和 200 日均线（$426.80）上方，略低于下行的 100 日均线（$446.30）。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方，现已升至零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$413.23），RSI 为 58。

read.en: The close cleared the $441.4 Oct 21 high, now support, and the $446.7 high met the 100-day. Resistance is $446.3–446.7 (100-day, Oct 28 high), then $454.7 (Aug 17 high) and $460.2 (Oct 6 high). Support is $441.4–441.5 (Oct 21 high, Oct 28 low), then $430–433 (5, 10 and 30-day) and $426.8 (200-day). A close above $446.7 would target $455–460; below $441, $433.
